title: Authentication failures on auth-svc
impact: Users were logged out or rejected on auth-svc
symptom: [ANOMALY] auth-svc 2026-06-25 11:54-14:54: auth-svc: 178 of 245 log lines were non-INFO between 2026-06-25 11:54 and 2026-06-25 14:54 UTC (peak error ratio 1.0 vs baseline median 0.0). 3 error templates, 2 first seen in this span.

_templates.macro: Terraform change moved {svc} to {new}; memory ran out, Redis evicted sessions and users were logged out in waves.
_templates.remediation: Restore {key} = {old} on {resource}; alarm on Evictions and DatabaseMemoryUsagePercentage.

rca.macro: Terraform change moved session-cache to cache.t4g.medium; memory ran out, Redis evicted sessions and users were logged out in waves.
rca.micro: infra/session-cache.tf:69 sets redis_node_type cache.r6g.xlarge -> cache.t4g.medium on aws_elasticache_replication_group.session_cache.
rca.remediation: Restore redis_node_type = cache.r6g.xlarge on aws_elasticache_replication_group.session_cache; alarm on Evictions and DatabaseMemoryUsagePercentage.

action_items: Require a reviewed `terraform plan` and a CloudWatch alarm for the changed AWS resource.
Alert on the error signature `{"level":"warn","msg":"session not found, forcing <*>`.
